policy: No two lanes own the same path. All lanes wide-safe-additive by default. Owned paths are NEW disjoint directories; existing shared primitives may be imported read-only.

lane_slots.theme: URL-drop safety check / repository intake / evidence drawer
live run console / evidence decision / install doctor / qualification

narrow_sensitive_writer.requires: separate explicit founder authorization naming the exact sensitive path

overlap_check_rule: Before build, compute the union of owned paths; if any path appears in two lanes, HOLD.
